title: Domain
description: A vocabulary: the entities and relationships of one subject, versioned together. uses names other domains whose entities this one may refer to. It names a vocabulary, never an organization. Three firms in one deal share a parties vocabulary and differ by instances of organization. A domain is not a tenant and not a database. Actions, rules, effects, and workflows are not part of this schema.

dna.description: The structure vocabulary this document is written in.

id.description: Stable id of this vocabulary. Other domains name it from uses.

uses.description: Other domains whose entities this one refers to. Each item is a domain id. An organization is an instance in a parties domain, not an entry here.

entities.description: The kinds of thing in this vocabulary.

relationships.description: The edges between those entities, including edges into domains named by uses.
